title: The Standing of a Granite Ridge Pass Account and the Share Taken on a Carry-Forward
content:
What service charges stand on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account reduces the share taken at that step of the carry-forward fee.

**First.** Where the pass account carries no service charge raised on it, seven tenths of that figure is taken, a share of 70 per cent.

**Second.** Where the service charges raised on the pass account come to less than half the carry-forward fee the tier carries — that is, less than a share of 50 per cent of the tier's published carry-forward fee — seventeen twentieths of that figure is taken, a share of 85 per cent.

**Otherwise.** In any other case the share taken is not reduced by this rule.

### The threshold read against the tier's own fee

| Service charges standing on the pass account | Share taken |
| --- | --- |
| none at all | 70 per cent |
| above nothing but below half the tier's carry-forward fee | 85 per cent |
| half the tier's carry-forward fee or more | not reduced by this rule |

The charges counted here are the service charges raised on that pass account, taken together as one figure; the threshold is half the carry-forward fee published for the tier, not half the fee being worked out on this election.

### Worked on hypothetical accounts

A Granite Ridge Summit Pass carries a carry-forward fee of 129.00, so half of it is 64.50.

| Service charges standing | Position against 64.50 | Share taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.00 | no charge stands at all | 70 per cent |
| 45.00 | below 64.50 | 85 per cent |
| 64.50 | not below 64.50 | not reduced by this rule |

On a figure of 129.00 carried into this step, a share of 85 per cent leaves 109.65.
